env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Contextual loGo/s words stay ordinary identifiers: the same
# declarations build and run under plain go, under logos for a Go
# module, and under logos for a loGo/s module.
cd go
go run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4 5 6$'
logos run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4 5 6$'
cd ../lgo
logos run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4 5 6$'
cd ..

# In a keyword position the same word is a statement in a loGo/s file
# and a syntax error in a Go file, under plain go and under logos.
cd kwpos
logos run .
stdout '^cleanup ran$'
stdout '^true$'
cd ../gobad
! go build .
stderr 'main\.go:11:[0-9]+: syntax error'
! logos build .
stderr 'main\.go:11:[0-9]+: syntax error'
cd ..

-- go/go.mod --
module example.com/kwgo

go 1.27

-- go/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	yield := 1
	scope := 2
	group := 3
	option := 4
	comptime := 5
	errdefer := 6
	fmt.Println(yield, scope, group, option, comptime, errdefer)
}

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/kwlgo

go 1.27

-- lgo/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	yield := 1
	scope := 2
	group := 3
	option := 4
	comptime := 5
	errdefer := 6
	fmt.Println(yield, scope, group, option, comptime, errdefer)
}

-- kwpos/go.mod --
module example.com/kwpos

go 1.27

-- kwpos/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

func cleanup() { fmt.Println("cleanup ran") }

func work() error {
	errdefer cleanup()
	return errors.New("fail")
}

func main() { fmt.Println(work() != nil) }

-- gobad/go.mod --
module example.com/gobad

go 1.27

-- gobad/main.go --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

func cleanup() { fmt.Println("cleanup ran") }

func work() error {
	errdefer cleanup()
	return errors.New("fail")
}

func main() { fmt.Println(work() != nil) }
